H01.description: Separator elision uses pattern_is_trailing_recursive, which is true for any suffix ending in `**`, so every `/` in multi-component patterns like `a/b/**` or absolute `{cwd}/**` (used by `ls **`) is dropped, producing wrong matches.

H02.description: Doc comment clarifying that pattern_is_trailing_recursive is not the separator-elision predicate.

H03.description: Adds the pattern_is_pure_trailing_recursive helper used by the D1 fix in H01.

H04.description: Adds a compiler regression test for a/b/** keeping intermediate separators.

H05.description: Adds glob walk tests for multi-component and absolute trailing `**` patterns.
